purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The official DLRS Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Office serves Mymensingh district; official land-record/survey services include mouza maps and cadastral/plot map searches. A public map-search client can load full per-sheet GeoJSON/vector tiles by administrative map selectors. For this city, public selectors returned Mymensingh district and one RS survey but zero thana/upazila units; no Mymensingh Sadar sheet or exact WUP polygon could be queried.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official DLRS Mymensingh office page lists the Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Officer under the Department of Land Records and Surveys.
Official DLRS directory assigns Mymensingh district to the Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Office and lists survey/mouza map services.
Official DLRS map-search page exposes administrative selectors for survey, district, upazila, mouza, sheet and dag; HTML shell returned HTTP 200.
Official Smart Bhumi Naksha page explains a mouza/plot land-use zoning program; it is not itself proof of cadastral parcel-vector coverage.
Official Mymensingh district map page offers district map material, not parcel vectors.
Official Mymensingh Sadar government service-process page includes land-record correction and khatiyan copy services; it supports local land-record activity, not anonymous parcel-vector geometry.

searchQueries.query: Mymensingh Bangladesh official cadastral parcel map land records survey office public GIS
searchQueries.result: Official DLRS sources establish a Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Office and a public map-search workflow with district/survey/upazila/mouza/sheet selectors. Its public selector returned zero upazila map units for Mymensingh district’s listed RS survey, so no exact-point feature was available. The separate Smart Land Map site is a mouza/plot land-zoning project, not verified parcel registry geometry.
